title: Quasi-topological gravity for 4-dimensional Taub-NUT, near-horizon extreme Kerr, and swirling symmetries
summary: We classify 4-dimensional gravitational theories with integrability properties analogous to quasi-topological gravity, but for metrics with the symmetries of spherical, hyperbolic, and planar Schwarzschild and Taub-NUT solutions, their double-Wick-rotated counterparts - the B-metrics, the near-horizon extreme Kerr, and the swirling universe - and the Eguchi-Hanson instanton. These are the symmetries that allow consistent reductions (principle of symmetric criticality) with 4 Killing vectors and 3-dimensional orbits.
